layout.note: Page grid from the 基本デザイン › Layout frame. Desktop 1280px screens use 12 columns; mobile (≤767px) uses 16px margins and gutters.

tokens.usage: Maximum content width on a 1280px desktop screen.

tokens.usage: Side margin on a 1280px desktop screen (32px minimum on wider screens).

tokens.name: layout-gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: Gutter between the 12 desktop columns.

tokens.name: layout-column-desktop
tokens.usage: Column width on a 1280px desktop screen.

tokens.name: layout-margin-mobile
tokens.usage: Side margin on mobile screens up to 767px.

tokens.name: layout-gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Gutter on mobile screens.

tokens.name: layout-breakpoint-mobile
tokens.usage: Widest mobile screen; switch to the desktop grid above it.

gradient.note: Gradients built from the system palette. The placeholder and scrim come from the source file; the rest are additions. Use them for large surfaces (banners, hero bands, image overlays), never for buttons, text or status.

tokens.name: gradient-key
tokens.usage: Key blue (blue-800 → blue-900 → blue-1000). Hero and campaign bands in the デジタル庁 theme; white text on it holds 7:1+.

tokens.name: gradient-crimson
tokens.usage: Crimson (red-900 → red-1000 → red-1100). Campaign and buy-area banners in the Marketplace theme; white text holds 5.6:1+.

tokens.name: gradient-key-tint
tokens.usage: Pale key wash (blue-50 → white) behind section headers or feature areas; body text solid-gray-800 reads on all of it.

tokens.name: gradient-crimson-tint
tokens.usage: Pale crimson wash (red-50 → white) behind sale or point sections in the Marketplace theme.

tokens.name: gradient-campaign
tokens.usage: Orange to red (orange-600 → red-900) for limited-time sale ribbons. White text only at 24px+ or bold 19px+ (the orange end is about 3.2:1).

tokens.name: gradient-placeholder
tokens.usage: Image placeholder from the source file (cyan-400 → purple-500). Only for empty image slots and mock-ups, never behind text.

tokens.name: gradient-scrim
tokens.usage: Bottom scrim from the source file (transparent → opacity-gray-400) laid over photos so a white caption at the bottom stays legible.
